title: lupinus arcticus var. prunophilus
intro: Lupinus arcticus var. prunophilus, commonly known as the Arctic Lupine, is a perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of western North America. It is known for its medicinal properties, which provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as cardiovascular and neurological protection. The therapeutic actions of Arctic Lupine include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antispasmodic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
